label: The hook layer is one policy tree (.skilled/hooks, 27 directories = 26 concern cores plus shared) plus three adapter forms: symlink discovery mirrors for Claude/Codex/Cursor/Devin wired from settings/hooks JSON, native plugin or extension modules for OpenCode/Pi/DSH, and 18 [[hooks]] entries in .vibe/hooks.toml for Vibe, which loads no JavaScript plugin.

The Codex mirror README is off by one against its own directory: it states 26 symlinks and 11 hook-core targets, while disk holds 27 links and 12 hook-core targets; the unnamed link is handover-compact-pointer.mjs to .skilled/hooks/session-handover/codex/. Arithmetic 12 + 10 + 5 = 27 confirms the listing.
Verified per-runtime adapter counts: Claude 32 symlinks, Codex 27, Cursor 25, Devin 29, OpenCode 20 plugin files, Pi 22 extension entries, DSH 22 registered adapters, Vibe 18 hook entries.

The four discovery mirrors are not identical sets: Claude adds fable-subagent-guard, session-prime and install-codex-hooks; Codex adds handover-prompt-seed and session-start; Devin adds permission-request-policy and post-compaction; Cursor adds spec-gate-prebind and precompact. The accurate statement is shared policy cores with runtime-specific adapters.
Cursor is the only runtime without an ask-surface adapter; the core description says seven runtimes register it and Cursor does not, and .cursor/hooks holds no ask-surface link.

Vibe's plugin README counts 21 OpenCode plugins while disk holds 20 .js plugin files; the OpenCode README records that one plugin was removed after the 2026-10-19 battery of 17 and the Vibe count was not updated.

DSH registers 22 adapters from a 24-file adapters directory; dsh-llm.mjs and session-role.mjs are helpers with no registration. A fan-out lineage leaf runs the bundle with four state-writing adapters switched off.
OpenCode is the only runtime where the goal state machine lives in the plugin (opencode-goal.js) rather than a shared core; Pi, DSH, Vibe, Cursor and Devin inject from .skilled/hooks/goal/.
All 27 .skilled/hooks core READMEs already carry a runtime-aware one-line description naming both job and coverage, so per-runtime README prose can be sourced from them instead of re-derived.

The eight-runtime claim is corroborated from the hook layer independently of the release notes: every one of the eight runtime directories carries a live adapter surface, confirming the Q4 finding that the six-name README line is the stale one.

The 27 hook-core directory count is correct: 26 concerns plus shared; six non-directory entries in the tree are documentation, flag files and the vitest config, which a directory count correctly excludes.
Dispatch next-focus named Q4 while the reducer-owned strategy marks Q4 answered; Q3 was selected as the only unchecked question and the prior iteration's recommendation.
